n_b_input = input().split()
n = int(n_b_input[0])
b = int(n_b_input[1])
array = list(map(int, input().split()))
values = [(-1 if x % 2 == 0 else 1) for x in array]

currentSum = 0
costs = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    currentSum += values[i]
    if currentSum == 0:
        diff = abs(array[i + 1] - array[i])
        costs.append(diff)

costs.sort()
total = 0
count = 0
for c in costs:
    if total + c <= b:
        total += c
        count += 1

print(count)
